title: 06 — Hosting: Cloudflare + MCP
summary: Maps every Atlas hosting and connectivity need to a specific Cloudflare primitive and defines remote-MCP access plus the Echo/Quill cloud-vs-local daemon split.
notes: Classified SPEC over DOC: contains implementation contracts (need→primitive map, least-privilege OAuth scope table per agent, the Wire event JSON shape, state-store access matrix) the system must honor, derived from SPEC-CANON sections. Heavy prose/rationale and an 'Open questions' section add DOC-like signal, hence medium confidence. SPEC-CANON.md is the authoritative parent spec; this is a derived hosting spec, not the canon itself.
